operations.title: Benincasa reports cyclic descent of physical soft Tate lines
operations.body: Entry 1125 passes the cyclic atlas test. The three fixed-base site-soft Tate generators all have unit Gysin coefficient and deck character -1. Cyclic relabelling preserves both external-normal and loop-edge residue orientations, acts by the regular 3-cycle matrix, and yields character (3,0,0), hence Q[C3]=Q_triv+Q(zeta3). There is no cyclic cocycle, but occurrence labels remain essential. Next candidate comparison is the invariant sum tau1+tau2+tau3 to the total-energy nearby Tate line, without collapsing the nontrivial Q(zeta3) summand.
